page.layout: Two blocks on one printed page, rotated on the scan. Left: a long column of V-names in very large, blurred type, with a large "V" initial at the top. Right: "INDEX AUTHORUM" heading, then a column of V-names continuing, then the W, X and Z sections below, with "FINIS" at the foot.

page.notes: The left column is printed in very large, heavily blurred and partly overprinted type, so most of its names and references could not be read and are not transcribed beyond the legible lines. Its lines appear in the order of the printed column; the marked lines at the top of the left column are reconstructed from fragments only. The right column is rotated and partly faded. The large "V" initial is not transcribed separately. Spellings of the right-column names such as "Vrspergensis" and "Vssherius" are doubtful. No page number or running head is printed.
